mapper.select: SELECT SCREEN_KEY, SCREEN_NAME, SCREEN_TYPE, SCREEN_VALUE, SCREEN_STATUS FROM REP_SCREEN where REP_ID = #{repId} AND SCREEN_STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY SCREEN_INDEX

select I.REP_ID, I.TEMPLATE_ID, I.TEMPLATE_PATH, I.REPORT_NAME, I.REPORT_TYPE from REP_INFO I LEFT JOIN REP_TREE T ON I.REP_ID=T.TREE_ID WHERE T.P_ID=#{repId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.FLAG='Y' and I.REPORT_TYPE = 'Y'
select REP_ID, TEMPLATE_ID, TEMPLATE_PATH, REPORT_NAME, REPORT_TYPE from REP_INFO where REP_ID = #{repId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and REPORT_TYPE = 'Y'
select PROD_ID prodId, PROD_ABBR prodName from REP_PROD_INFO where STATUS='E' and p_prod_id is null /*不取子产品*/

SELECT PROD_ID prodId, PROD_RE prodRe, PROD_NAME prodName, PROD_ABBR prodAbbr, RAISE_MIN raiseMin, RAISE_MAX raiseMax, RAISE_STRDATE raiseStrdate, RAISE_ENDDATE raiseEnddate, RAISE_CCY raiseCcy, SET_DATE setDate, VDATE vdate, FIRST_OPEN_DAY firstOpenDay, MDATE mdate, ACT_MDATE actMdate, TERM term, WINDUP_DATE windupDate, ISSUE_MODE issueMode, PROFIT_TYPE profitType, PROD_TYPE prodType, ISSUE_STATUS issueStatus, RAISE_TYPE raiseType, RISK_LEVEL riskLevel, REVEAL_CHANNEL revealChannel FROM REP_PROD_INFO WHERE 1=1 AND PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT rr.ID id, rr.RULE_NAME ruleName, rr.REP_NAME repName, rr.REP_ID repId, rr.RCF_TYPE rcfType, rr.RCF_VALUE rcfValue, rr.BASIS_DATE_TYPE basisDateType, rr.MAKE_TYPE makeType, rr.MAKE_VALUE makeValue, rr.MAKE_DATE_TYPE makeDateType, rr.MAKE_TIME makeTime, rr.REVEAL_TYPE revealType, rr.REVEAL_VALUE revealValue, rr.REVEAL_DATE_TYPE revealDateType, rr.REVEAL_TIME revealTime, rr.DATA_TYPE dataType, rr.DATA_RANGE dataRange, rr.DATA_BEGIN dataBegin, rr.DATA_END dataEnd, rr.DATA_VALUE dataValue, rr.FILE_OUT_TYPE fileOutType, rr.REVEAL_CHANNEL revealChannel, rr.FTP_ID ftpId, rr.IS_REVEAL isReveal, rr.IS_CONFIRM isConfirm, rr.DETAIL detail FROM REP_RULE rr WHERE 1=1 AND REP_ID = #{repId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT ERRORMSG FROM REP_CHECK_ERRMSG WHERE REP_ID = #{rep_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.delete: delete from REP_CHECK_ERRMSG where REP_ID = #{rep_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or REP_ID='null'
mapper.select: SELECT PROD_NAME FROM REP_PROD_INFO WHERE PROD_ID = #{prod_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and p_prod_id is null /*不取子产品*/

select rjr.ID as id, rjr.JOB_ID as jobId, rjr.FLAG as flag, rjr.RULE_TYPE1 as ruleType1, rjr.RULE_TYPE2 as ruleType2, rjr.RULE_TYPE3 as ruleType3, rjr.RULE_TYPE4 as ruleType4 from REP_JOB_RANGE rjr where rjr.JOB_ID=#{repId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
